input.summary: Make the no-consent assignment carve-out Customer-only, bar Kubient from assigning to our competitors, and confirm no Kubient termination right on our change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have limited the no-consent affiliate/successor carve-out to AP so that Kubient still needs our consent (not unreasonably withheld) to assign, added a bar on assignment to an AP competitor, and confirmed that a change of control of AP gives Kubient no termination right.

ops.oldText: that either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets
ops.newText: that Customer may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of Customer's assets

ops.text: Kubient may not assign this Agreement to any competitor of Customer, and no change of control of Customer shall give Kubient any right to terminate this Agreement.
